name: Support
description: Scopes the session to multi-app team support work — resolves app names to local repo paths, dispatches parallel investigation lenses, and allows mid-session pivots between apps.

appMap.label: App Map
appMap.description: Maps app short names to their local repo paths. Leave a value empty for TPM to ask for the path when needed.

scriptLanguage.label: Script Language
scriptLanguage.description: Default language for investigative scripts. sql (default): generates T-SQL queries. csharp: generates LINQPad C# script bodies. Overridden per-app by App Script Overrides.

appScriptOverrides.label: App Script Overrides
appScriptOverrides.description: Per-app overrides for Script Language. Keys must match App Map entries; values are sql or csharp. Apps without an entry here use the global default.

investigationLenses.label: Investigation Lenses
investigationLenses.description: Comma-separated SWE investigation lenses TPM deploys in parallel on a reported issue: reproduction narrows the trigger, code-path traces execution to the failure, regression checks recent changes. Reorder or trim to change the shape.

pivotBehavior.label: Pivot Behavior
pivotBehavior.description: How TPM handles a mid-investigation app switch. accept (default): pivot immediately. confirm: ask first. refuse: block pivots until the current investigation wraps.

knowledgeFilePerApp.label: Knowledge File Per App
knowledgeFilePerApp.description: When on, TPM maintains a persistent per-app knowledge file at Support/<APP>.md in the vault. When off (default), findings live in session memory only. Requires tool.obsidian-notes.
